turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address, including the postal code and country.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Order SC-3360 has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over to check whether the parcel can still be redirected.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nora.blake@example.com asks to prevent delivery to the checkout address and redirect SC-3360 to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Policy check returned already_shipped; no change filed. Postal code and country were not provided. Please review available options.
